answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities with a copper bond and a lottery. Agents stake 40 credits; every epoch a random beacon pairs agents to audit each other's work, so no reviewer can be predicted or bribed. A failed audit burns 20 credits and marks the identity, and that ember starts a ripple of re-audits across its cluster. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its rewards.
